summary: Retested the iteration_3 fixes. New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iter4_fixes.py: 16/16 pass on the first run, then 15 pass and 1 skips after the owner switched employees to ERP mode. It covers: bonus for a resource not on any row or on an absent row returns 400 on preview and create; unknown or inactive BONUS_TYPE returns 400; Safety $10 and Bad Weather 2.5 x 9h = $22.50 are not flagged, while $10.50 and $23 are flagged validation.special with 'above rate card'; a $50 bonus on submit is accepted and routed to approval; foreman redaction on preview, create, list and get (no lines rate/cost, no totals.cost, cost_transactions empty) while admin and PM still see costs and the DB keeps the cost; foreman /master now includes bonus amounts; DELETE of a local project with tasks returns 409 and works once the task is deleted; DELETE of an employee used in a plan returns 409 and works once the plan is deleted; status change on an ERP project returns 400 and leaves it unchanged; lookup order is stored as a number; autofill today for PRJ-1042/Civil-WBS-3/Crew-A returns the plan. Regression test_master_data.py: 14 pass, 1 skip (employees in ERP mode); bonus submit to full approval with a B1 cost line passes. UI (Playwright): as foreman on /labor, Load from plan gives 3 rows, there is no Est. cost column and no $ total in the ValidationPanel, Safety pre-fills 10, Bad Weather pre-fills 22.5, recalculates to 27.5 after OT is set to 3 and to 25 after Apply defaults (8+2), Add row gives no 400, and submit gives LAB-00045 pending step1. As admin, the Est. cost column and the $864.00 total show. MasterList: ERP project 300000079140539 shows status 'Approved' (disabled, ERP note shown, no Deactivate button); New defaults status to Active; task row testids are unique (500/500, md-row-PI50001-0) and so are lookup testids (40/40, md-row-BONUS_TYPE-SAFETY); lookup order shows 34. All requested fixes are verified. The remaining issues are small and listed below.

minor.issue: The foreman Dashboard still shows $ actual, approved and pending cost, plus $ per task and resource type. Rate redaction covers transactions only. Decide whether the dashboard should hide $ for the foreman.
Duplicate bonuses for the same resource and type are not rejected, and the absent-row check returns 400 instead of ignoring a stale bonus (see the UI bug).

Employees in crews (if crews hold members), lookups used by employees (GRADE, CRAFT etc.) and tasks used in plans are still not checked before delete. The project-with-tasks and employee-in-plan cases are fixed.

ui_bugs.component: UsageEntry labor: absent row with flat bonus
ui_bugs.issue: If Safety is set on a row and the row is then unchecked (Present off), the bonus stays in e.bonuses and preview returns 400 'employee must be on a present row'. useEntry swallows the error (setPreview(null)), so the ValidationPanel disappears without a message and Submit stays enabled; the user only sees an error toast on submit. Fix: filter bonuses with r.present && r.resource_number in the UsageEntry setBonuses effect, and show preview errors inline.
The Cost column shows '$0.00' for every entry because totals.cost is now redacted. Hide the column for the foreman, as UsageEntry does with showRates.
